name: EOS Cube
rootCause: The attacker justjiezhan1 launched an attack on the EOS game "cubecontract" and has already made a profit. Prior to this, the attacker justjiezhan1 started deploying the attack contract at around 12:00:41 on the same day. The analysts preliminary analyzed that the attacker was, still the same as the previous attack mean, transaction congestion attack.
